name: Sacrilege
overview: Sacrilege in Scripture is shown as a serious offense involving the disrespect or unauthorized handling of what God has set apart as holy. Examples include Esau selling his birthright (Genesis 25:33), Nadab and Abihu offering unauthorized fire before the Lord (Leviticus 10:1; Numbers 3:4), and the profaning of sacred things which brings judgment (Leviticus 19:8). Jesus' cleansing of the temple by driving out the money-changers (Matthew 21:12) further emphasizes God's demand for reverence and purity in worship, warning against treating holy things with irreverence or for personal gain.
